PreToolUse.command: node -e "const p=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_TARGET||''; const r=[/^\.env(\..+)?$/, /\.pem$/, /\.key$/, /^credentials\..+$/, /^\.git\//]; const n=p.replace(/^\.?\//,''); if(r.some(x=>x.test(n))){ console.error('Blocked edit to protected path: '+p); process.exit(2);} process.exit(0);"

PostToolUse.command: bash -lc 'f="${CLAUDE_TOOL_TARGET}"; [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.js) npx -y prettier --write "$f";; *.py) black "$f";; *.go) gofmt -w "$f";; *.rs) rustfmt "$f";; *) true;; esac'

SessionStart.command: echo "Use the project's package manager. Run /verify before claiming completion. Never edit protected files."
